method: Broad Fortinet Community product-area searches plus topic-specific searches; Community/KB material is scenario-only, never used as the primary lesson source.
result_note: Search results contained few directly matched recent scenarios for today's selected feature mechanisms. Older or adjacent articles are recorded as context only; no unrelated article was represented as a direct scenario.

products.search_query: FortiGate technical tip troubleshooting FortiOS 8.0; graceful BGP shutdown gshut
products.disposition: BFD/GR HA failure is an adjacent operational boundary, not the graceful-shutdown feature itself.

products.search_query: FortiManager technical tip troubleshooting 8.0; PDE password object import
products.disposition: Install mismatch article is general context only; no PDE-import-specific scenario found.

products.search_query: FortiAnalyzer technical tip NTP authentication SHA-256; NTP high latency and synchronization
products.disposition: NTP latency article is related time-quality context only; it does not document SHA-256 authentication.

products.search_query: FortiSwitch managed switch trusted hosts FortiLink REST API configuration synchronization
products.disposition: Community scenario directly demonstrates FortiLink source IP omitted from trusted-host list causing REST API login/config-sync failure; official FortiLink guide remains primary.

products.search_query: FortiAP wireless technical tip troubleshooting; wired uplink 802.1X supplicant
products.disposition: Search results surfaced DARRP material, but it was unrelated to uplink supplicant authentication and was excluded.

products.search_query: FortiNAC technical tip troubleshooting 9.4; IPv6 portal and agent
products.disposition: Support collection guidance is not an IPv6 scenario; no direct IPv6 failure scenario found.

products.search_query: FortiNAC-F technical tip troubleshooting 7.6; TEAP local RADIUS
products.disposition: Recent N+1 upgrade scenario is not TEAP and was not used as TEAP lesson evidence.

products.search_query: FortiAuthenticator technical tip troubleshooting 8.0; RADSec accounting client certificate
products.disposition: Push notification upgrade issue is unrelated to RADSec and was not used.

products.search_query: FortiPAM technical tip troubleshooting 1.9; launcher process matcher
products.disposition: Community feature overview is not a troubleshooting scenario; used only to confirm the release context, not as primary lesson evidence.

products.search_query: FortiSIEM technical tip troubleshooting 7.5.1; Windows certificate monitoring agent
products.disposition: No directly matched Community scenario found.

products.search_query: FortiSASE technical tip troubleshooting; agent-based ZTNA destination IP range/subnet
products.disposition: On-ramp slowness scenario is unrelated to destination object scoping and was not used.

products.search_query: FortiGate Secure SD-WAN technical tip troubleshooting; FortiGuard SLA database
products.disposition: Generic health-check article is older context only; primary lesson uses official FortiGuard SLA database documentation.
